result_revision: Uncommitted working tree; staging, commits and pushes remain with the user.
scope: Server-only SQLite store foundation: explicit atomic creation, supported-version reopen, immutable store/world identity, exclusive local ownership and bounded validation. No character/economy mutation API or player protocol.

hardware.scope: CPU server storage on the current PC and retained WSL; no new graphics or capacity qualification

cpu_tests.count_scope: Selected passing profiles; the interrupted failed Release attempt remains recorded separately.

environment_interruption.reason: Windows sleep interrupted the first Release run; its sole failed CTest was shark.tooling.processes (timeout).
environment_interruption.commands_and_acceptance_limits: Identical to the frozen original driver; only output directory and completed Debug reuse differ.

wsl_sdk_free_runtime.scope: fresh installed Server and EnTT/GLM, all eight locked MbedTLS notices and verified SQLite public-domain notice in retained SDK-free pinned Ubuntu runtime userspace; isolated network; shared WSL kernel; writable rootfs

preflight_findings: Windows page-size fixture initially used VACUUM, which requires disabled ATTACH; replaced with an explicit unsupported-header case.
Windows process fixture initially used narrow argv and lost Unicode path characters; probe now uses native wide arguments.
GCC warnings-as-errors found three copied structured bindings; corrected to const references.
Independent review corrected compound SELECT limit 0 (unlimited) to 1 and preserved I/O/SQLite error categories.
Independent review found empty AssertionError could falsely pass the supervisor; explicit failure state, nonempty diagnostics and eight actual-main controls now reject it.
limits: Only the recorded Windows PC and existing retained WSL userspaces are qualified; no hosted or other-machine evidence is claimed.
Process termination and hot-journal recovery are software recovery tests, not physical power-loss or disk-loss qualification.
One creating-thread owner holds an exclusive local database connection; this is not distributed region fencing or concurrent external SQL support.
Main-file cap is 16 MiB, admitted rollback journal 32 MiB, suggested page cache 1 MiB; these are not total process-memory or disk quotas.
Server bootstrap remains idle and does not automatically open a database; public storage services are exercised through test executables.
Character/session durability, economy deduplication, complete crash/outage matrix, migrations and backup/restore retain M03b-f.
No new GPU, audio, real network population or MMO capacity claim is made.
